verdict.rationale: Airbyte exposes multiple headless surfaces relevant to an AI agent: a full REST API for programmatic control (docs-3/18/46), PyAirbyte for Python/AI developers to extract and load data in code (docs-1/47), a Terraform provider for config-as-code (docs-19), a CLI-like abctl for deployment (docs-13), and documented MCP servers letting agents like Claude/Cursor/Codex connect to Airbyte data (docs-6, probe-3). Together these support scaffolding, configuring, and running pipelines without the UI, and access-token based auth is documented (docs-17). However, there is no first-party or community walkthrough showing an agent autonomously scaffolding a brand-new connector, wiring a full sync, and executing it end-to-end purely via CLI/API/MCP in one flow — the pieces are separately documented rather than shown as one cohesive headless pipeline lifecycle. missing for 10: an end-to-end demonstration/tutorial of an agent creating+configuring+running a full pipeline unattended, and independent/community confirmation that this headless flow works reliably.
